name: znetwork_dplay_refresh_and_get_service_provider_list
description: zNetworkDPlay::RefreshAndGetServiceProviderList refreshes the DirectPlay service-provider vector and returns g_zNetwork_ServiceProviderList.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The wrapper is verified with the same smoke as the provider-list refresh dependency.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a130 validates the wrapper call to zNetwork_DPlay::RefreshServiceProviderList followed by returning g_zNetwork_ServiceProviderList.
The native smoke verifies RefreshAndGetServiceProviderList triggers a second refresh and returns the global provider-list vector.
